text:
Type: upholstered storage bench with lift-up lid
Use: extra seating and hidden storage by a sofa, a window or a bed; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: tightly woven fabric upholstery, padded seat, black-stained turned wooden legs
Colors: dark charcoal grey fabric, black legs
Shape: long rectangular upholstered box with a padded overhanging lid, piped edge, small fabric pull tab, four short turned legs, low and substantial
Feel: cozy, refined, deep, comfortable
Goes with: grey or velvet sofas, dark wood, brass accents, patterned rugs; classic or traditional living rooms and bedrooms

product.name: STOCKSUND
product.description: Storage space under the seat. The lid stays open so you can safely and easily take things in and out.
